purpose: Candidate retrieval, scoped feature lookup, and concept-graph membership. LLM review decides identity and applicability.

object.definition: $$x_{t+1}=Ax_t+Bu_t+w_t,\qquad x_t\in\mathbb R^{d_x},\quad u_t\in\mathbb R^{d_u},\quad x_0=0.$$ The matrices $A,B$ are fixed and unknown. The disturbance sequence is fixed before interaction and satisfies $\|w_t\|_2\le W$; independent random noise is not assumed. The cost functions $c_t(x,u)$ are fixed in advance, differentiable, and convex. For every radius $D\ge1$, $\|x\|_2,\|u\|_2\le D$ implies $\|\nabla c_t(x,u)\|_2\le GD$. A stabilizer $K_0$ is known, and the closed-loop system admits the decomposition $$A-BK_0=QLQ^{-1},\qquad \|L\|_2\le1-\gamma,\qquad 0<\gamma\le1,$$ $$\max\{\|A\|_2,\|B\|_2,\|K_0\|_2,\|Q\|_2,\|Q^{-1}\|_2\}\le C_{\mathrm{stab}}.$$ Strong controllability additionally requires the following matrix to have full row rank and satisfy $$C_k=[B,(A-BK_0)B,\ldots,(A-BK_0)^{k_{\mathrm{ctrl}}-1}B],\qquad \|(C_kC_k^{\mathsf T})^{-1}\|_2\le C_{\mathrm{ctrl}}.$$

operation.query_signature: Observe the full state $x_t$, choose $u_t$, incur $c_t(x_t,u_t)$, and then receive the complete current cost function and next state. Neither $A,B$ nor the disturbance is directly revealed. Arbitrary causal controllers are allowed; the algorithm is not restricted to a particular linear feedback form. Inputs $d_x,d_u,T,G,W,K_0,\gamma,C_{\mathrm{stab}},C_{\mathrm{ctrl}},k_{\mathrm{ctrl}},\delta_{\mathrm{conf}}$ are public. Received feedback may be stored and reused computationally. No unrevealed historical information or extra queries to exhausted samples are available; any within-round full-function or common-sample access must be explicit.

comparators.definition: $$\begin{gathered}K\in\mathcal K\ \Longleftrightarrow\ \exists Q_K,L_K:\ A-BK=Q_KL_KQ_K^{-1},\\ \|L_K\|_2\le1-\gamma,\qquad \max\{\|A\|_2,\|B\|_2,\|K\|_2,\|Q_K\|_2,\|Q_K^{-1}\|_2\}\le C_{\mathrm{stab}}.\end{gathered}$$ $$R_T=\sum_t c_t(x_t,u_t)-\min_{K\in\mathcal K}\sum_t c_t(x_t^K,-Kx_t^K).$$

definition.comparator_class: All K satisfying A-BK=Q_sim L_stab Q_sim^-1, ||L_stab||<=1-gamma, and ||A||,||B||,||K||,||Q_sim||,||Q_sim^-1||<=C_stab; comparator uses the same initial state and disturbance sequence.
definition.costs: Obliviously fixed differentiable convex c_t(x,u); for every D>=1, ||x||,||u||<=D implies ||gradient c_t(x,u)||<=G D; full cost function revealed after action.
definition.dynamics: x_(t+1)=A x_t+B u_t+w_t, state in R^d_x, input in R^d_u, fixed unknown A,B; x_0=0
definition.stability: supplied K_0 with A-BK_0=Q L Q^-1, ||L||<=1-gamma and ||A||,||B||,||K_0||,||Q||,||Q^-1||<=C_stab

protocols.adversary_information: Follow the model and oracle timing. Current private random realizations are not visible to the environment.
protocols.loss_bearing_points: Sequentially output control inputs $u_t\in\mathbb R^{d_u}$ and evaluate the actual system trajectory. Each comparator controller induces its own counterfactual states; learner states cannot be substituted for them.
protocols.past_requery: History may be stored. New information from old samples or past rounds is unavailable unless the native interface explicitly permits it.
steps: Observe the complete state $x_t$, choose $u_t$, and incur $c_t(x_t,u_t)$; then receive the complete current cost function and next state.
Neither $A,B$ nor the disturbances themselves are supplied directly. Any causal controller is allowed; algorithms are not restricted to a particular linear feedback form.

Received feedback may be stored and reused in computation. Unrevealed information cannot be requested from past rounds, and consumed random samples cannot receive additional queries. Current-round exceptions are limited to the explicitly supplied full-function access or same-sample two-point interface.

variable_blocks.space: The current control input is $u_t\in\mathbb R^{d_u}$; observed states belong to $\mathbb R^{d_x}$.
